events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.88)
events.body:
The driver cancelled this RydeX trip at 13:05:40 and the $6.61 cancellation fee was charged to the rider [F4][F8]. Under NS-0 the case is routed through the cancelled_by = driver branch (NS-1/NS-2), because the driver asserts a rider no-show [F4][F12][NS-0]. RydeX is a non-metered service, so the disputed item is the published $6.61 cancellation fee and no per-km meter arithmetic applies [F8][RD-2].

NS-1 requires all three of (i) "I'm Here" pressed, (ii) GPS showing the driver within the pickup radius at the moment of the tap, and (iii) more than 3 minutes (≥ 3:01) of waiting at the pickup before cancelling [F6][F2][NS-1]. Elements (i) and (ii) are satisfied: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:45 while 41 m from the pickup point [F6][NS-1]. Element (iii) fails: the driver remained continuously inside the 200 m radius for only 175 s (2 min 55 s) after the tap before cancelling, below the 181 s threshold [F6][NS-1]. The driver's chat claim of waiting "more than 3 min" [F11] and his statement [F12] are statements that yield to the GPS/timeline records [F6][F2][NS-1]. The timeline record of "4 min 30 s after arrival" [F5] runs from first entry into the radius at 13:01:10 [F2], not from the "I'm Here" tap, so it cannot rescue element (iii) [F5][F6][NS-1].

Because NS-1 is not fully satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 fee must be refunded in full to the rider [F4][F8][NS-2]. Amount computation is not metre-based; the trace fixes the refundable item at the cancellation fee of $6.61 [F4][F8][NS-2]. No waiting fee arises on this non-metered service [F8][RD-3].

The additional NS-2 flag_account condition is not triggered: the driver did press "I'm Here" while genuinely within the radius (41 m) [F6][F1], so there was no false arrival tap requiring an account flag [F6][NS-2]. The driver's profile (0 prior disputes/upheld, 651 trips) [F17] is noted but not used to decide this case, since profile facts never decide a case alone. Traffic context (band 3, no incidents) [F13][F14] and weather [F15] are irrelevant to a no-show fee determination [RD-4][NS-1].
